name: claude
description: The window as the Claude app: warm near-black paper with the clay accent, replies in a clean sans in a narrow reading column, your prompt in a soft rounded pill, round tabs and panes, sessions by project with their branch and pull request. Every New Tab is Claude's home (a greeting, one prompt box that starts a Claude chat, your recents), the sidebar carries Claude's usage left, and each chat's Session Info gets a Claude Code status line. Command-N starts a Claude chat.

files.themes/claude-app.json:
// The Claude app: a warm near-black page, a darker sidebar on its own surface, the clay accent,
// no borders, and the app's soft round corners on tabs, rows, buttons and panes. Colors from the
// claude-code-app recipe (manaflow-ai/cmux#45804); edit and save, the window repaints at once.
{
  "name": "Claude app",
  "description": "Warm near-black paper, a darker sidebar, the clay accent, round corners, no borders.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "colors": { "background": "#1f1e1c", "foreground": "#ececea", "selection": "#3a3936", "cursor": "#d97757", "accent": "#d97757" },
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#181816",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1f1e1c",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",


  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  // Shape, not only color (Leo: "customizing the tabs/sidebars a lot deeper"): the Claude app's soft pills: 10 pt tab and row corners, a 288 pt sidebar with roomy rows set in from its edge, Claude's own sidebar look, Session Info pushing the chat aside, the top right buttons only on hover.
  "density": { "basedOn": "comfortable", "tokens": {"tabCornerRadius": 10, "tabCloseCornerRadius": 6, "verticalTabCornerRadius": 10, "sidebarCornerRadius": 10, "itemCornerRadius": 8, "panelCornerRadius": 14, "sidebarWidth": 288, "sidebarRowHeight": 32, "sidebarRowGap": 2, "sidebarRowInset": 8, "tabGap": 4, "browserRowHeight": 30 } },
  "sidebar.look": "claude",
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "off",
  "window.titlebarButtons": "hover",
  "tabs.plusButton": "hover",
  "agentPane.display.sessionInfo.placement": "push"
}
